selection_frozen_before_retrieval: exclude every module id and normalized query text already used by the 76-case development set and the 35+20+26 source-attested holdouts
exactly one mapped target inside the frozen 316-skill P80 envelope
target preferred label must not occur directly in the description
description must be non-terse natural source text
description must contain at least one pure integer token under the same research tokenizer used by the candidate
include every eligible P80 skill, with at most two deterministic rows per skill
no retrieval/model/scoring code available to the builder

result.terminal_error: no natural unused source-attested numeric holdout exists under the frozen criteria

decision.query_only_numeric_sanitation: do not promote; opened-data development evidence is promising but no independent natural source-attested validation remains under the defensible prefrozen criteria
decision.criteria_relaxation: rejected; do not lower the source-quality/leakage/independence criteria merely to manufacture a validating slice
decision.synthetic_substitute: rejected for promotion evidence; do not construct numeric examples after seeing the candidate behavior
decision.current_low_complexity_recommendation: plain frozen G1+T3 without numeric sanitation
decision.revisit_trigger: new independent human/user or source-attested numeric descriptive queries become available, or a measured production failure makes numeric-token handling material

methodological_note: Failure to obtain an independent holdout is itself a boundary result. It prevents converting a favorable opened-data ablation into an evidence claim stronger than the data supports.
